corrections.why: The list tags the tower gfc-317. The US prefix matches the NHLR-style 'US ####' numbering and does not appear in the source.

notes_for_editor: Single-source record: the tnlandforms list gives coordinates, elevation and a tag but no build date, design, height, agency, status or access. The name 'white house' is the list author's own, not a USGS or official name, so treat the name as provisional. The GFC number is probably a Georgia Forestry Commission number, but the list does not say what 'gfc' means; the correction proposes dropping the US prefix only. Not on the NHLR Georgia list. Story body is about 90 words because nothing more was found. Not verified on the ground.
